role: Remediation after E1.1 showed stable action value but insufficient enrichment from five hand-written strata.
population: Same 419 development tasks; no untouched validation or C9 access.
positive_label: specialist exceeds anchor by >0.05 on at least two of three repeats
inner_threshold_selection: Three-fold OOF inside each outer training fold; maximize training-only mean action gain over thresholds 0.50..0.95 subject to harmful-switch rate <=0.25 and at least max(5,2%) switches.
overall_gate: At least one specialist-feature variant passes every gate.
selection_rule: Among passing variants choose highest OOF action gain; ties prefer structure, then combined, then tfidf.
pass_action: Freeze the selected anchor-specialist switch router and run a final untouched cross-repeat action audit.
failure_action: Do not collect broad data; construct a targeted decomposition pilot from stable-positive, anchor-positive, and unstable tasks.
